naslov: Record budget revealed for Real Madrid in the 2026–2027 season
tekst:
By Stefan Acevski / info@eurohoops.net
Real Madrid’s basketball budget for the 2026-27 season has been disclosed, with the EuroLeague finalist poised to escalate their expenditure to an unprecedented level.
As reported by 2Playbook, Real Madrid’s basketball section will have a record-setting budget of €67.2 million for the 2026-27 season.
This surge in investment follows the club’s basketball operations posting record losses of €33.2 million in the previous 2025-26 season, with the football department’s revenue assisting in offsetting the shortfall.
Furthermore, Real Madrid has amplified its personnel budget to €52.7 million for the current season, with €44.4 million for players and coaching staff.
In comparison, the basketball department’s overall personnel costs amounted to €48.6 million last season, which is roughly €10 million more than in the 2024-25 season.
